summary: Compact list projections admit only short scalar fields (corpus rows carry the full FTS body in _pp_body_text, so frequency-based keep rules re-import it) and derive a bounded snippet; read's agent envelope stamps meta.source live (it is a live command; the printOutputWithFlags default misreported local); archiveWalk reports WHY it ended (exhausted vs limit-stopped, --limit 0 = whole archive); read is variadic with per-post error entries in an envelope array.
reason: Dogfooded on a real corpus: search --agent returned entire article bodies per hit despite --compact's key-fields promise (and read misreported provenance as local), 'Archived 50 posts' at the default --limit read as a complete archive, and multi-post reads forced bash for-loops. All are honesty/ergonomics contracts a regen must preserve, not spec-derived behavior.
validated_outcome: amend_compact_test.go pins the compact scalar gate + snippet bound and the live-provenance meta plumbing; archive_test.go pins exhausted=false on a limit stop and true only on an empty page; read multi-arg smoke-tested via --dry-run.
